name: Вариант 0 - существующее состояние (без изменений)
concept: Исходная планировка как есть. Нужна как база сравнения: любой другой вариант читается как разница с ней.
!!_base_spec_removed_2026_09_17: !! It named data/canonical/current_apartment_base.json, which is RETIRED. v0 is no longer assembled from a base spec plus operations - it is COMPILED directly from resolve_v0_geometry.resolve(), the same compiler the DXF and the IFC come from. A base_spec pointing at a superseded file kept a retired input in the comparison's dependency chain even after the spec itself was rebuilt.
